import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int r, c, n;
    static char[] s;
    static long[][] comb;
    static int[] cntA, cntB;
    static List<Long>[] partial, partialZero;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] inputLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        r = Integer.parseInt(inputLine[0]);
        c = Integer.parseInt(inputLine[1]);
        s = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        n = 2 * (r + c);
        comb = new long[n + 1][n + 1];
        cntA = new int[n + 1];
        cntB = new int[n + 1];
        initializeLists();

        computeComb();

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            cntA[i] = cntA[i - 1] + (s[i - 1] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            cntB[i] = cntB[i - 1] + (s[i - 1] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }

        computeSecondPart();

        long sol = computeFirstPart();

        System.out.println(sol);
    }

    static void initializeLists() {
        partial = new ArrayList[c + 2];
        partialZero = new ArrayList[c + 2];
        for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; i++) {
            partial[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            partialZero[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void computeComb() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    static long getDifs(int conf, int a_bef, int b_bef) {
        long ans = 0;
        long aux1, aux2;
        for (int i = 0; i <= c; i++) {
            if ((conf & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                b_bef++;
                aux1 = comb[b_bef - 1][r - 1];
                aux2 = comb[n - b_bef][r] - comb[a_bef][r];
                ans -= aux1 * aux2;
            } else {
                a_bef++;
                aux1 = comb[a_bef - 1][r - 1];
                aux2 = comb[n - a_bef][r] - comb[b_bef][r];
                ans += aux1 * aux2;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static boolean check(int conf) {
        int length = 2 * r + c;
        for (int i = 0; i <= c; i++) {
            if (s[2 * r + c + i] == 'A' && ((conf >> i) & 1) == 1) return false;
            if (s[2 * r + c + i] == 'B' && ((conf >> i) & 1) == 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void computeSecondPart() {
        int limit = 1 << (c + 1);
        for (int conf = 0; conf < limit; conf++) {
            int b_here = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            int a_here = c + 1 - b_here;
            if (check(conf))
                partial[a_here].add(getDifs(conf, r + c - a_here, r + c - b_here));
            else
                partialZero[a_here].add(getDifs(conf, r + c - a_here, r + c - b_here));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; i++) {
            Collections.sort(partial[i]);
            Collections.sort(partialZero[i]);
        }
    }

    static long getCoef(int conf) {
        int i;
        for (i = 0; i <= c; i++) {
            if ((((conf >> i) & 1) != (conf & 1))) break;
        }
        for (int j = i; j <= c; j++) {
            if (s[2 * r - 1 + j] == 'A' && (((conf >> j) & 1) == 1)) return 0;
            if (s[2 * r - 1 + j] == 'B' && (((conf >> j) & 1) == 0)) return 0;
        }
        int set_a = r - 1 + (((conf & 1) == 0) ? i : 0);
        int set_b = r - 1 + (((conf & 1) == 1) ? i : 0);
        if (set_a < cntA[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
        if (set_b < cntB[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
        int total = set_a + set_b - cntA[2 * r - 2 + i] - cntB[2 * r - 2 + i];
        return comb[total][set_a - cntA[2 * r - 2 + i]];
    }

    static void update(Pair ans, Pair act) {
        if (act.first < 0) act.first = -act.first;
        if (ans.first < act.first) return;
        if (ans.first > act.first) {
            ans.first = act.first;
            ans.second = act.second;
            return;
        }
        ans.second += act.second;
    }

    static long howMany(List<Long> data, long val) {
        int lower = lowerBound(data, val);
        int upper = upperBound(data, val);
        return upper - lower;
    }

    static long computeFirstPart() {
        int limit = 1 << (c + 1);
        long ansFirst = 1L << 60;
        long ansSecond = 0;

        for (int conf = 0; conf < limit; conf++) {
            int b_here = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            int a_here = c + 1 - b_here;
            long act = getDifs(conf, r - 1, r - 1);
            long coef = getCoef(conf);
            int idx = lowerBoundIndex(partial[c + 1 - a_here], -act);
            if (idx < partial[c + 1 - a_here].size()) {
                long val = partial[c + 1 - a_here].get(idx);
                if (Math.abs(val + act) <= ansFirst) {
                    long coef2 = howMany(partial[c + 1 - a_here], val);
                    Pair tmp = new Pair(Math.abs(val + act), coef * coef2);
                    if (ansFirst >= tmp.first) {
                        if (ansFirst > tmp.first) {
                            ansFirst = tmp.first;
                            ansSecond = tmp.second;
                        } else {
                            ansSecond += tmp.second;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (idx > 0) {
                long val = partial[c + 1 - a_here].get(idx - 1);
                if (Math.abs(val + act) <= ansFirst) {
                    long coef2 = howMany(partial[c + 1 - a_here], val);
                    Pair tmp = new Pair(Math.abs(val + act), coef * coef2);
                    if (ansFirst >= tmp.first) {
                        if (ansFirst > tmp.first) {
                            ansFirst = tmp.first;
                            ansSecond = tmp.second;
                        } else {
                            ansSecond += tmp.second;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // coef = 0
            int idxZero = lowerBoundIndex(partialZero[c + 1 - a_here], -act);
            if (idxZero < partialZero[c + 1 - a_here].size()) {
                long val = partialZero[c + 1 - a_here].get(idxZero);
                long coef2 = howMany(partialZero[c + 1 - a_here], val);
                if (Math.abs(val + act) <= ansFirst) {
                    long totalCoef2 = howMany(partialZero[c + 1 - a_here], val);
                    Pair tmp = new Pair(Math.abs(val + act), 0);
                    if (ansFirst >= tmp.first) {
                        if (ansFirst > tmp.first) {
                            ansFirst = tmp.first;
                            ansSecond = totalCoef2;
                        } else {
                            ansSecond += totalCoef2;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (idxZero > 0) {
                long val = partialZero[c + 1 - a_here].get(idxZero - 1);
                long coef2 = howMany(partialZero[c + 1 - a_here], val);
                if (Math.abs(val + act) <= ansFirst) {
                    long totalCoef2 = howMany(partialZero[c + 1 - a_here], val);
                    Pair tmp = new Pair(Math.abs(val + act), 0);
                    if (ansFirst >= tmp.first) {
                        if (ansFirst > tmp.first) {
                            ansFirst = tmp.first;
                            ansSecond = totalCoef2;
                        } else {
                            ansSecond += totalCoef2;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return ansSecond;
    }

    static class Pair {
        long first;
        long second;

        Pair(long first, long second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long val) {
        int low = 0;
        int high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) < val) low = mid + 1;
            else high = mid;
        }
        return low;
    }

    static int upperBound(List<Long> list, long val) {
        int low = 0;
        int high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) <= val) low = mid + 1;
            else high = mid;
        }
        return low;
    }

    static int lowerBoundIndex(List<Long> list, long val) {
        return lowerBound(list, val);
    }

    static int upperBoundIndex(List<Long> list, long val) {
        return upperBound(list, val);
    }
}
